lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10 distinct vertical white lines are visible. The central 5 lines exhibit the highest contrast and length with roughly equal spacing, while the anterior and posterior lines are shorter and more faintly defined.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 1st, 2nd, and 3rd anterior lines terminate mid-flank. The posterior-most lines are fragmented into short dashes rather than continuous segments traversing the torso height.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 3 distinct, high-contrast white spots is visible on the upper posterior haunch, positioned above the white-haired fringe of the hindquarters.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots located on the mid-posterior flank align horizontally to form a brief linear geometric pattern.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a spiral lyrate trajectory, emerging laterally and posteriorly from the skull before curving medially and superiorly toward the terminal points.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 1.4 times the total pixel width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Bright ivory-colored tipping is visible at the apex of both horns, comprising approximately 10-12% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a prominent white transverse chevron between the orbital regions, two white spots on the lateral mandible, and high-contrast white bands at the carpal and tarsal junctions above tan-colored distal limbs.
